newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK toy maker seen in HK$108.8 mln float - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK toy maker seen in HK$108.8 mln float - sources.

text.p: Toy maker Kin Yat Holdings Ltd is expected to issue 85 million new shares at HK$1.28 each, raising HK$108.8 million before expenses in an initial public offering (IPO) of shares, market sources said on Tuesday.
Sources said the issue price would represent a price to earnings multiple of 6.3 times on a fully-diluted basis.
The IPO is expected to kick off next week and dealing in the shares is seen beginning later this month, sources said.
Kin Yat is expected to hold a presentation on Wednesday, they said. Lippo Securities is seen to be the sponsor of the issue, sources added.
The Hong Kong-based company manufactures remote control toy sports cars. About 63 percent of the products are for export to the United States and 18 percent to Europe, sources said.

From the net proceeds of HK$96.80 million, HK$36 million is expected to be used to build a factory in China and to buy machinery, HK$10 million for products development, HK$3 million to upgrade equipment, and the balance for general working capital, sources said.
